title: Time Jump — 08:15, Water Conservation in Effect

fields.narration: It is now 08:15 on Saturday, March 14, 2026. The Central Plant potable water tank holds 37,300 gallons, and consumption has slowed to approximately 1,300 gallons per hour due to conservation measures. The city water fill valve has been manually closed to prevent intake of advisory-affected water. All elective surgical cases have been cancelled. Sterile Processing has suspended all instrument reprocessing. The outpatient and inpatient dialysis programs are fully suspended. Nine outpatients and 24 inpatients now require a formal plan for renal replacement therapy. The City of Toledo Department of Public Utilities has not issued a time to lift the Do Not Drink advisory. The hospital remains at Level 2 activation.

instructorNote: This time jump advances the incident to the point where dialysis continuity planning must be initiated. Watch for the team to activate the EHR Downtime Procedures Annex (ORRMC-DT-ANX-2026) and the Cyber Incident Response Plan (ORRMC-CIRP-2026), particularly around the BCA-VIEW01 read-only viewer and the printed census and MAR packet.
